records.text: With glittery high top golden goose sneakers, her fingers capped in a fresh set of baby pink acrylic nails were embellished with Super Bowl sized rings featuring her kids initials, a blinding diamond or engagement ring, and a copy of Charlie (Charlie Kirk)'s presidential medal of freedom.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
